summary: Inverness aerodrome traffic zone deactivated and aerodrome closed during daily controller rest periods, 1330-1415, 1615-1700 and 1900-1945.
text:
INVERNESS ATZ DEACTIVATED. AD CLSD FOR MANDATORY ATC CONTROLLER 
REST PERIOD. HELIMED AND COASTGUARD MAY STILL OPR FM HEL EMERG 
SERVICES BASES. PILOTS TRANSITTING THE AREA ARE ADVISED TO MONITOR 
122.605. TIMES MAY BE SUBJ TO SHORT NOTICE CHANGE. ALL DEP MUST BE 
AIRBORNE 15 MIN BEFORE CLOSURE.
